name: com.navercorp.nid.oauth.activity.NidOAuthWebViewActivity
description: The NAVER ID Login SDK declares this Activity for an older embedded-browser sign-in route. In the inspected version, the login flow reports that route as deprecated and does not open this screen.
disableEffect: Disabling this retired screen does not affect the NAVER app or browser-tab sign-in routes supported by this SDK version.
